class.name: BoneClothCollision3D
class.brief_description: A base class of the collisions that interact with [BoneClothSimulator3D].
class.description: A collision has an effect only as a child of [BoneClothSimulator3D]. It pushes out the simulator's joints and links, in scene tree order. If [member bone] is set, the collision follows the bone's pose with [member position_offset] and [member rotation_offset]. Moving or rotating the collision updates the offsets. Scale is ignored; use the shape's size properties instead.

method.name: get_skeleton
method.description: Returns the [Skeleton3D] of the parent [BoneClothSimulator3D], or [code]null[/code] if there is none.

members.member: The index of the attached bone. [code]-1[/code] is no bone.
The name of the attached bone.
The position offset from the [member bone] pose, along the bone's axes.
The rotation offset from the [member bone] pose.
